Event-centred post-fire NBR response by land-cover class, single-fire pixels. 'dNBR_year1/2_mean' are whole-year block means minus the pre-fire year, so the annual cycle cancels; 'rel_dNBR_year2_mean' divides by the pre-fire level where it exceeds 0.01 (n_rel pixels). Negative = below pre-fire. The '*_fires_2018_2019' columns repeat year 2 for fires in 2018-2019 only, so every class is compared over the same calendar period.

**Sources (array → column).**

- `NBR values` — nbr_raw.npy (valid months only, X_scaled_mask.npy == True)
- `fire month / single-fire selection` — y_burned.npy (labelled-month count == 1)
- `land_cover` — X_scaled_meta.csv['lc_dominant']
- `recovery_gap_target_mean` — targets_aux.npz['recovery_gap']
